  print('CASE',label,'exit',p.returncode);print(p.stdout);print(p.stderr)
  assert p.returncode==(0 if label in ['baseline','restored'] else 1),label
finally:path.write_text(original)
print('PASS: 4/4 controlled template mutations rejected; baseline/restored green')
